Summary: Built a real Claude Code plugin marketplace at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (schema verified live against Anthropic docs), with one plugin entry per existing skill (21 total) -- reusing skills/ in place via source:'./' + per-entry skills paths, no duplication or restructuring of existing content. This is distinct from and doesn't touch the pre-existing .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, which is a separate convention read by the .NET runtime's MarketplaceSkillsMaterializer.cs.

Only ceo has a commands/ entry (evolve-colony) -- the other 20 plugins are skills-only by design; add commands to other domains only when a specific slash-invokable workflow is actually wanted, not preemptively.
